ADI.name: Analog Devices, Inc.

ADP.name: Automatic Data Processing, Inc.

ADP.invalidation_criteria: Major recession causing severe white-collar corporate employment contraction.

ADSK.name: Autodesk, Inc.

AEP.name: American Electric Power Company, Inc.

ALNY.name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

AMGN.name: Amgen Inc.

SHOP.moat: Dominant direct-to-consumer commerce platform, high switching costs for merchants, expanding take rate via Shop Pay and enterprise Shopify Plus.
SHOP.invalidation_criteria: Consumer discretionary spending collapse leading to merchant churn, or competitive pricing pressure from native social commerce.
SHOP.latest_catalyst: Enterprise merchant wins, Shop Pay off-network transaction volume expansion, and free cash flow margin ramp >15%.

SHW.name: The Sherwin-Williams Company
SHW.description: Develops, manufactures, and distributes paints, coatings, and related products to professional, industrial, commercial, and retail customers.
SHW.moat: Exclusive 5,000+ store dedicated retail distribution network, unbeatable painter contractor loyalty and pricing power, leading industrial coatings franchise.
SHW.invalidation_criteria: Major commercial and residential construction contraction or raw material (titanium dioxide, resins) cost spikes without pricing pass-through.
SHW.latest_catalyst: Professional contractor market share gains and architectural paint volume recovery.

SLDP.name: Solid Power, Inc.
SLDP.description: Develops all-solid-state rechargeable battery cells and sulfide-based solid electrolyte materials for electric vehicles and other markets.
SLDP.moat: Sulfide solid electrolyte patents and automotive partnerships (BMW, Ford); offset by lack of commercial revenue, multi-year EV qualification cycles, and cash burn.
SLDP.invalidation_criteria: Partner OEM program cancellations or cash runway dropping under 12 months.
SLDP.latest_catalyst: A-sample battery cell validation and electrolyte sampling expansion.

SNPS.name: Synopsys, Inc.
SNPS.description: Global leader in electronic design automation (EDA) and semiconductor intellectual property (IP), accelerating silicon-to-systems design.
SNPS.moat: Dominant market share in digital semiconductor logic synthesis and verification, extensive interface IP catalog, pending Ansys simulation acquisition.
SNPS.invalidation_criteria: Antitrust block or major integration breakdown of Ansys acquisition.
SNPS.latest_catalyst: Synopsys.ai generative design suite adoption and multi-die 3D-IC chiplet design platform demand.

STOK.name: Stoke Therapeutics, Inc.
STOK.description: Biotechnology company pioneering antisense oligonucleotides (TANGO platform) to restore protein levels in severe genetic diseases like Dravet syndrome.
STOK.moat: Proprietary TANGO RNA upregulation platform; offset by early-stage clinical risks, lack of commercial revenues, and ongoing equity financing needs.
STOK.invalidation_criteria: Safety issues in zorevunersen Phase 3 trials or regulatory design disagreements with the FDA.
STOK.latest_catalyst: Phase 3 registrational study initiation for zorevunersen in Dravet syndrome.

STX.name: Seagate Technology Holdings plc
STX.description: Provides data storage technology and infrastructure solutions, leading the transition to Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording (HAMR) enterprise hard drives.
STX.moat: Pioneering HAMR (Mozaic 3+) areal density technology enabling 30TB+ to 40TB+ hard drives, essential low-cost tier for AI training datasets.
STX.invalidation_criteria: HAMR manufacturing yield bottlenecks or faster-than-expected price declines in enterprise QLC flash.
STX.latest_catalyst: Mozaic 3+ HAMR volume qualification with major cloud service providers.

TDOC.name: Teladoc Health, Inc.
TDOC.description: Provides virtual healthcare services, telehealth consultations, and chronic condition management (BetterHelp, Integrated Care).
TDOC.moat: Scale in virtual healthcare; severely impaired by commoditization of telehealth visits, surging customer acquisition costs for BetterHelp, and massive goodwill write-downs.
TDOC.invalidation_criteria: Continued contraction in BetterHelp paying users and inability to generate GAAP net income.
TDOC.latest_catalyst: Operational cost restructuring under new leadership.

TEAM.name: Atlassian Corporation
TEAM.description: Designs, develops, and licenses team collaboration and productivity software including Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Jira Service Management.
TEAM.moat: Standard developer workflow platform (Jira), high enterprise switching costs, low sales & marketing cost structure with virality.
TEAM.invalidation_criteria: Deceleration of enterprise cloud migrations or customer churn to GitHub/GitLab suites.
TEAM.latest_catalyst: Atlassian Intelligence AI assistant adoption and enterprise Cloud tier expansion.

TMUS.name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
TMUS.description: Provides wireless voice, messaging, and data services under the T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile brands, and fixed wireless 5G home internet.
TMUS.moat: Mid-band 5G spectrum lead, lowest cost-per-gigabyte network architecture, dominant share of postpaid phone net additions.
TMUS.invalidation_criteria: Broadband market share losses to fiber overbuilders or destructive price competition from cable MVNOs.
TMUS.latest_catalyst: 5G Home Internet fixed wireless expansion and massive shareholder capital return via dividends and buybacks.

TRI.name: Thomson Reuters Corporation
TRI.description: Provides authoritative information, software, and AI solutions for legal, tax, accounting, and compliance professionals (Westlaw, Checkpoint, CoCounsel).
TRI.moat: Proprietary legal and tax content archives, high switching costs in enterprise law firms and corporate tax departments, CoCounsel GenAI legal assistant.
TRI.invalidation_criteria: Loss of Westlaw market share to generative AI startups.
TRI.latest_catalyst: CoCounsel GenAI legal assistant adoption and Westlaw Precision upgrade cycle.

TRV.name: The Travelers Companies, Inc.
TRV.description: Provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance products and services to businesses, government units, associations, and individuals.
TRV.moat: Disciplined underwriting culture, commercial lines broker relationships, proprietary risk analytics, and high investment portfolio yields from higher interest rates.
TRV.invalidation_criteria: Sustained catastrophic weather losses driving combined ratio above 102% or adverse prior-year reserve development.
TRV.latest_catalyst: Commercial lines premium rate increases outpacing loss-cost inflation and investment income growth.

TSLA.name: Tesla, Inc.
TSLA.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and leases electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and solar installations.
TSLA.moat: Manufacturing scale, Supercharger network standard (NACS), Full Self-Driving neural network data fleet, Megapack energy storage growth.
TSLA.invalidation_criteria: Failure to achieve unsupervised FSD autonomy, severe automotive gross margin compression below 14%, or loss of EV market leadership.
TSLA.latest_catalyst: Robotaxi autonomous network reveal and Megapack Shanghai factory ramp.

TTWO.name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
TTWO.description: Develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment software across Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga (Grand Theft Auto, NBA 2K, Red Dead).
TTWO.moat: Grand Theft Auto franchise (highest-grossing entertainment property in history), NBA 2K annual sports franchise, recurring online microtransactions.
TTWO.invalidation_criteria: Grand Theft Auto VI release delay beyond late 2025/2026 or major creative missteps.
TTWO.latest_catalyst: Grand Theft Auto VI worldwide launch and Zynga mobile advertising recovery.

TXN.name: Texas Instruments Incorporated
TXN.description: Designs and manufactures analog and embedded processing chips for industrial, automotive, personal electronics, and communications equipment.
TXN.moat: Low-cost 300mm analog wafer manufacturing advantage (40%+ cost savings vs 200mm), 80,000+ catalog products, unmatched customer diversity.
TXN.invalidation_criteria: Prolonged inventory overhang in automotive/industrial markets or aggressive Chinese mature-node analog dumping.
TXN.latest_catalyst: Completion of 300mm fab buildout inflection and industrial cyclical demand recovery.

UNH.name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
UNH.description: Diversified healthcare company operating UnitedHealthcare (health benefits) and Optum (OptumHealth clinical care, OptumRx pharmacy benefit manager, Optum Insight data analytics).
UNH.moat: Massive healthcare ecosystem integrating insurance with clinical care and pharmacy benefits, unmatched data analytics, and high return on capital (>22% ROIC).
UNH.invalidation_criteria: Medical loss ratio (MLR) structurally exceeding 87% or aggressive federal PBM regulatory reform destroying OptumRx margins.
UNH.latest_catalyst: Medical loss ratio stabilization, OptumHealth clinic expansion, and Medicare Advantage rate adjustments.

V.name: Visa Inc.
V.description: World's largest retail electronic payments network, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities.
V.moat: Unassailable global payments network effect (>4.3B cards issued), 67%+ operating margin, extraordinary free cash flow conversion, and pricing power.
V.invalidation_criteria: DOJ antitrust litigation forcing card routing concessions or mandated interchange fee reductions.
V.latest_catalyst: Value-added services revenue growth (Visa Direct, risk & security solutions) and cross-border payment expansion.

VRSK.name: Verisk Analytics, Inc.
VRSK.description: Provides data analytics, risk assessment, and predictive underwriting tools to the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry.
VRSK.moat: Monopoly database of historical insurance actuarial claims in the US, essential rating software embedded into insurer workflows, >80% recurring revenue.
VRSK.invalidation_criteria: Regulatory scrutiny on proprietary insurance rate database pricing.
VRSK.latest_catalyst: Catastrophe modeling software demand and insurance claims automation tools.

VRTX.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated
VRTX.description: Discovers and develops transformative medicines for serious diseases including cystic fibrosis (Trikafta), sickle cell (CASGEVY), and acute pain (Suzetrigine).
VRTX.moat: Cystic fibrosis monopoly (>90% market share), non-opioid acute/neuropathic pain franchise (Suzetrigine), $10B+ net cash balance sheet.
VRTX.invalidation_criteria: FDA approval rejection or clinical safety issues in suzetrigine pain franchise.
VRTX.latest_catalyst: Suzetrigine FDA approval in moderate-to-severe acute pain and CASGEVY commercial ramp.

VZ.name: Verizon Communications Inc.
VZ.description: Provides communications, technology, information and entertainment products and services to consumers, businesses and government entities.
VZ.moat: Extensive 5G wireless network and fiber infrastructure; however, burdened by massive debt load ($125B+), high capital intensity, and intense pricing competition from T-Mobile.
VZ.invalidation_criteria: Postpaid phone subscriber losses or dividend coverage strain from heavy spectrum and debt servicing costs.
VZ.latest_catalyst: Fixed wireless access (5G Home) broadband growth and Frontier fiber acquisition.

WBD.name: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.
WBD.description: Premier global media and entertainment company offering content across television, film, streaming (Max), and gaming (HBO, Warner Bros, DC).
WBD.moat: Legendary content IP vault (Harry Potter, DC Comics, HBO, Lord of the Rings), global streaming subscriber ramp.
WBD.invalidation_criteria: Debt load sustainability concerns or accelerated linear TV advertising decline.
WBD.latest_catalyst: Max global rollout, rapid net debt reduction, and DTC streaming EBITDA growth.

WDAY.name: Workday, Inc.
WDAY.description: Provides cloud enterprise software for human capital management (HCM), financial management, and analytics to the world's largest corporations.
WDAY.moat: Over 50% of the Fortune 500 rely on Workday for mission-critical core HR and financial planning, >95% customer retention, expanding operating margins.
WDAY.invalidation_criteria: Deceleration of 12-month subscription revenue backlog below 12%.
WDAY.latest_catalyst: Workday Illuminate AI platform integration and enterprise Financials suite adoption.

WDC.name: Western Digital Corporation
WDC.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices including hard disk drives (ePMR/UltraSMR HDDs) and solid-state drives (Flash/NAND).
WDC.moat: Duopoly in nearline mass-capacity enterprise HDDs (with Seagate), UltraSMR capacity density leadership for cloud hyperscaler storage.
WDC.invalidation_criteria: Severe cloud storage capex pause or execution friction in planned corporate separation into Flash and HDD standalone entities.
WDC.latest_catalyst: Spin-off separation of Flash business to unlock pure-play market valuations.

WMT.name: Walmart Inc.
WMT.description: Engages in retail and wholesale operations, operating grocery and merchandise stores, hypermarkets, and e-commerce platforms across the US and international markets.
WMT.moat: Unmatched physical store proximity (within 10 miles of 90% of US population), massive grocery purchasing power, fast-growing high-margin retail media advertising (Walmart Connect), and automation.
WMT.invalidation_criteria: Operating margin compression below 3.5% or severe loss of market share in grocery to discounters.
WMT.latest_catalyst: Supply chain automated fulfillment center rollout and Walmart Connect advertising high-margin profit growth.

XEL.name: Xcel Energy Inc.
XEL.description: Regulated electric and natural gas delivery company serving 3.7 million electricity and 2.1 million natural gas customers across eight Western and Midwestern states.
XEL.moat: Regulated monopoly service territories, high rate-base growth supporting renewable energy transition and data center power demand.
XEL.invalidation_criteria: Catastrophic wildfire liability exceeding insurance reserves.
XEL.latest_catalyst: Clean energy transmission infrastructure expansion and data center load additions.

XYZ.name: Block, Inc.
XYZ.description: Operates the Square small-business merchant ecosystem, Cash App consumer digital wallet platform, and decentralized financial infrastructure.
XYZ.moat: Two-sided network effects across Cash App consumer banking and Square merchant point-of-sale ecosystem with integrated software solutions.
XYZ.invalidation_criteria: Cash App gross profit monetization slowdown, market share loss to alternative digital wallets, or regulatory enforcement on digital asset transactions.
XYZ.latest_catalyst: Rule of 40 operational efficiency target execution and Square merchant distribution expansion.

ZM.name: Zoom Communications, Inc.
ZM.description: Provides a unified communications and collaboration platform including Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone, Zoom Team Chat, and Contact Center.
ZM.moat: Frictionless video conferencing brand; however, growth has decelerated to low single digits due to fierce competition from Microsoft Teams bundled with Office 365.
ZM.invalidation_criteria: Enterprise customer net expansion rate falling below 98% or ongoing margin compression in AI contact centers.
ZM.latest_catalyst: Zoom AI Companion adoption and Zoom Contact Center enterprise wins.

ZS.name: Zscaler, Inc.
ZS.description: Cloud security company providing the Zero Trust Exchange platform that securely connects users, applications, and devices over any network.
ZS.moat: Pioneering distributed cloud proxy security architecture (150+ data centers globally), high enterprise switching costs, Zero Trust standard.
ZS.invalidation_criteria: Deceleration in annual recurring revenue growth below 18% or margin compression.
ZS.latest_catalyst: Zero Trust SASE and AI security operations product suite adoption.
